name: Move partner service and API partner admin code under devrel ownership
description:
## Why?

Partner Portal work in this epic keeps touching the legacy API partner and partner service admin pages: /admin/api-partner/ (settings, OAuth, addons, statistics) and /admin/pridat-partnerskou-sluzbu/ with all its tabs, including Endpointy and Testovací instalace. Those files have no CODEOWNERS entry today, yet every change waits on api-team review, and PRs in this epic are blocked on that right now. Only the OAuth client secret handling and the CRM token service are genuinely api-team domain.

## What?

Devrel owns the partner service and API partner admin pages end to end: the controllers, their page props, Smarty templates, React pages and the models behind them, moved under the Partner Portal namespace. The api team keeps OAuth client creation and secret rotation in a dedicated class in the OAuth2 package, keeps the CRM token service, and gets explicit ownership of the OAuth2 and Webhook packages. Nothing changes for merchants or partners; the pages behave exactly as before.

## Acceptance criteria

Every file behind /admin/api-partner/ and /admin/pridat-partnerskou-sluzbu/ (all tabs) and the other PartnerService* admin pages (submit, suspend, restore, cancellation, ratings, tariff change, iframe, rights, shipping service detail) resolves to @shoptet/devrel-team in CODEOWNERS.

OAuth client creation, client secret regeneration and the redirect URI whitelist live in one class owned by @shoptet/api-team; the admin pages only read the values for display.

/cms/packages/OAuth2 and /cms/packages/Webhook resolve to @shoptet/api-team.

No file in the repository references the old class locations.

Existing unit and integration tests for the moved code pass unchanged; no functional change on any of the pages.

A PR touching these pages needs api-team approval only when it changes the OAuth client class.

## Technical notes

> Generated by Claude Fable 5.1, on 2026-09-25

- Legacy controllers move to admin/controllers/PartnerPortal and are resolved through the admin route map; templates and Props stay in place and get CODEOWNERS globs.
- The ApiPartner and ApiService models and the Partners helper move to cms/packages/PartnerPortal/Infrastructure/Legacy. The ApiPartner model is used by about 44 files outside these pages, so the rename touches CRM, cron and notification code, mostly import lines and the PHPStan baseline.
- OAuth client handling is extracted from the ApiPartner model into cms/packages/OAuth2 and injected back, so the model keeps its public API.
- api-team.md already lists OAuth2 and Webhook as owned; CODEOWNERS does not enforce that today.
- Integration tests for the moved model need a seeded test database.
